name: optimize_csharp_list_dedup
description: Optimizes an O(n^2) nested-loop integer de-duplication method to O(n) using a HashSet
prompts: This C# project (app.csproj targets net8.0) contains Dedup.cs with a static method `Dedup.RemoveDuplicates(List<int> input)` that removes duplicate integers while preserving the order of first occurrence. It currently does this by checking each item against every item already added to the result list in a nested loop, which is O(n^2) and becomes too slow for large inputs (tens of thousands of elements). Rewrite RemoveDuplicates in Dedup.cs to run in O(n) time using a `HashSet<int>` to track which values have already been seen, while preserving the exact same behavior: the returned list must contain each distinct value exactly once, in the order of its first occurrence in the input.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
